name: kkyum
author: jm33-ng
comment: Load the signed kkyum kernel driver in memory via the in-memory driver loader (driver_load_bytes)
help: Load, unload, or query the signed kkyum Windows kernel driver in memory through the agent's driver loader. action=load installs and loads the driver under service; action=unload stops and removes it; action=status reports whether it is loaded. Only signed drivers load, and the target agent needs administrator rights. The .sys image is staged in encrypted memfs and never written to disk as plaintext.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action to take: load, unload, or status

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Driver service name to install/load under
